metadata.name: Raptor: Call of the Shadows
metadata.summary: Reverse-engineered native source port of the classic vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up

content.value: Raptor: Call of the Shadows is an open-source, reverse-engineered native source port of the classic 1994 vertical-scrolling shooter originally developed by Cygnus Studios. Built upon nukeykt's reverse-engineering work and utilizing SDL2, it brings authentic DOS-era gameplay and audio to modern Linux desktops without requiring DOS emulation.
To play, original game asset files (GLB format, version 1.2 or higher) from either the shareware or registered release are required and can be loaded seamlessly from standard user data directories.

items.value: Native modern platform execution powered by SDL2
Full compatibility with both shareware and registered full game data files (v1.2+)
Automatic creation and handling of default SETUP.INI configuration files
Standard XDG data directory support for game assets, configurations, and save states
Faithful recreation of original 1990s vertical-scrolling arcade gameplay mechanics
